verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a password manager. It has no user-authored automation or workflow artifacts, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The CLI, the APIs, the API backward-compatibility policy, and vault export cover access, interface versioning, and data backup, not automation version control, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
